title: Lesson Assignment – Lesson Allocation Archived – Manually-Assigned Session Also Hidden (No Assignment_Source Protection); Restored – Manual Session Reappears
description: Gap/contrast case - Decision Table - contrasts directly with this suite's design philosophy (e.g. case 26899, "Change Location Course – Active Class Ends – Existing Manual Session in Old Class Lesson Retained", where a manual session survives class-based reconciliation): archiving the Lesson Allocation hides a manually-assigned Student Session exactly like an automatically-assigned one, because Is_Archived__c is purely parent-driven and carries no Assignment_Source__c awareness - the manual-session protection built into the reconciliation batches does not apply here. The session reappears correctly once the Lesson Allocation is restored, since the underlying record was only hidden, never deleted.
preconditions:
- Student A has an active Lesson Allocation for Course A. Staff has manually assigned Student A to Lesson B (Assignment_Source__c = Manual) - Student A currently appears in Lesson B's Student Sessions.
- Student A is separately an active Class A member and is auto-assigned (Assignment_Source__c = Auto) to Lesson A - Student A currently appears in Lesson A's Student Sessions too.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens both Lesson A's and Lesson B's Student Session lists"
2. "The Student Package Order behind Student A's Course A Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens both Lesson A's and Lesson B's Student Session lists"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Course A Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff reopens both Lesson A's and Lesson B's Student Session lists"
steps_result:
1. "Student A appears in both - the automatic session in Lesson A and the manual session in Lesson B"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
3. "Student A no longer appears in EITHER list - the manually-assigned session in Lesson B is hidden exactly like the automatic one in Lesson A, unlike how class-based reconciliation (case 26899) would have protected it"
4. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "Student A reappears in both - the same original sessions, not newly created; the manual session in Lesson B is restored with its Assignment_Source__c still Manual"
steps_data:
1. "Lesson A session Assignment_Source__c = Auto; Lesson B session Assignment_Source__c = Manual; both Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Both sessions' Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden regardless of Assignment_Source__c"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Both sessions Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored); Assignment_Source__c unchanged by the archive/restore cycle"

title: Lesson Assignment – Restored Lesson Allocation – Dedup Logic Force-Unassigns a Restored Manual Session on Lesson Collision (No Assignment_Source Protection)
description: Gap case - Decision Table - UnarchivedSessionDeduplicator (the restore-time collision cleanup in LessonAllocationSyncService) force-unassigns one of two sessions that collide on the same (Lesson, Student) pair after a restore, but its collision query has no Assignment_Source__c filter - so if the LOSING side of that collision happens to be a manually-assigned session, it gets unassigned (Lesson__c cleared) exactly like an automatic one would, with no special protection, even though this suite's reconciliation batches would never have removed that same manual session under normal (non-archive) circumstances.
preconditions:
- Student A has a Lesson Allocation for Course A with a manually-assigned session (Assignment_Source__c = Manual) on Lesson X, created before the allocation was archived.
- While the Lesson Allocation was archived, a different, newer Lesson Allocation (or the same allocation re-synced) ends up with another Student Session also pointing at Lesson X for Student A - e.g. via a re-import or re-assignment that occurred during the archive window, creating a same-lesson collision once both sessions are live again.
- The original Lesson Allocation is then restored (Archived_At__c cleared).
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff confirms both Student Session records exist for Student A on Lesson X before the restore completes"
2. "The Lesson Allocation finishes restoring (Archived_At__c cleared) and UnarchivedSessionDeduplicator runs"
3. "HQ or CM Staff checks which of the two sessions was unassigned"
steps_result:
1. "Two Student_Sessions__c records exist for the same (Lesson X, Student A) pair, one of them the original manually-assigned session"
2. "The deduplicator detects the (Lesson X, Student A) collision and force-unassigns the losing session's Lesson__c, Assigned_Lesson__c, and Lesson_Report__c fields"
3. "If the original manually-assigned session is the one selected as the losing side, it is unassigned exactly like an automatic session would be - Student A's manual assignment to Lesson X is silently lost, with no error or warning that a manual assignment was overridden"
steps_data:
1. "Original session: Assignment_Source__c = Manual, Lesson_Allocation__c = the restored LA"
2. "UnarchivedSessionDeduplicator.collectSessionsToUnassign has no Assignment_Source__c filter in its collision query"
3. "Manual session has no protection against being the collision loser during restore-time dedup"
